study_line: A461-PSMI (Policy-Semantic Monotonicity under Native Pointer-Head Interventions)
reviewer: session executing the registered A461-PSMI G-1 (independent targeted search; not a reuse of A461/A462 literature-round ledgers, which remain partial)
falsifiable_hypothesis: On SecJev-0.8B native typed policy decisions with independently executable source-local rule Gold (Twins certificate_action truth table over C=conflict,Q=quorum; LANL triage truth table over R=burst,F=current-failure), there exist rule-preserving evidence-addition counterfactual pairs - constructed inside one frozen scene by appending events that pass the same observable eligibility rules, with policy text, validator/destination identities, and choice menu unchanged - such that the model's strict policy action moves in the policy-NON-monotone direction (e.g., adding a valid quorum vote raises the reject-related margin; adding conflict evidence raises the accept margin; adding a trusted in-window failure de-escalates triage), beyond matched-length neutral-event format controls.
decision_scope: GO for CPU admission gate only (source-local counterfactual pair construction + dual-oracle validation + negative controls + input freeze). No GPU permission is granted or implied by this document; any model forward requires the separate explicit user GPU approval with its own budget.

primary_papers.title: SecJev: Bringing Security Expertise to System One Decision Models
primary_papers.what_was_read: Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1 read directly (A461 2026-10-24 and A462 2026-10-24 rounds quote the specific native question types and shared-LoRA+pointer-head architecture); architecture confirmed against pinned SecJev-0.8B component hashes in this repository.
primary_papers.solved: Defines the model under study: typed independent causal question rows (conflicting_vote / quorum / evidence_level / certificate_action; failure_burst / triage), shared Q/K pointer scorer, Twins and LANL native sources. Publishes the task schemas this experiment freezes.
primary_papers.not_covered: No monotonicity property of the scorer is stated, measured, or guaranteed; no rule-preserving evidence-addition pairs; no source-local counterfactual Gold recomputation on edited scenes.
primary_papers.our_delta: First to test whether the scorer's own policy semantics is monotone under policy-relevant evidence addition, using oracle-recomputed Gold on both arms of within-scene pairs.
primary_papers.duplicate_falsifier: If SecJev v2 or a successor paper already reports evidence-addition monotonicity violations on these native sources, this experiment is redundant (REJECT_REDUNDANT).

primary_papers.title: One Word Opens the Gate
primary_papers.version: v1, 2026-10-08; abstract page read this session; full-text HTML was previously unreachable (recorded in A461 memo), section-level reading via public research summary in A461 round
primary_papers.solved: Typed decision models as agent guardrails; fail-open vs fail-closed asymmetry; attacker-controlled additions of six policy-irrelevant log lines raise fail-open 0%->63%; option-renaming attacks 93-100%; all tested defenses defeated.
primary_papers.not_covered: Evidence added by the honest system itself (no attacker), policy-RELEVANT additions whose Gold legitimately changes or stays fixed per an executable oracle; oracle-validated rule-preserving pairs; native structured scenes (Twins/LANL); monotone direction analysis; any white-box readout.
primary_papers.our_delta: We test the scorer under evidence additions that are policy-relevant and oracle-evaluable, contrasting violations against matched-length neutral additions - a different claim than 'irrelevant text flips decisions'.
primary_papers.duplicate_falsifier: If our violation pairs cannot be distinguished from matched-length neutral-event controls (equal violation rates), the phenomenon collapses into their irrelevant-text finding re-instantiated on another model: REJECT_REDUNDANT for the behavioral claim.

primary_papers.title: Monotonicity as an Architectural Bias for Robust Language Models
primary_papers.version: v1, 2026-02; method and results sections read directly this session
primary_papers.solved: Proposes semantically-monotone FFN update on T5-small; shows adversarial-attack success drops 63%->19% on summarization with ~3% ROUGE cost. Motivates evidence-strengthening orderings conceptually.
primary_papers.not_covered: No empirical decision-reversal benchmark from evidence addition; no security or authorization task; no typed/pointer readout; no counterfactual minimal pairs or oracle Gold; no measurement of whether an unmodified production scorer violates monotonicity.
primary_papers.our_delta: We provide the missing measurement side: an oracle-validated monotonicity-violation test on a real security-typed scorer, which their architecture work presupposes but never evaluates.
primary_papers.duplicate_falsifier: Not a duplication risk for the behavioral claim; a duplication risk only if our contribution is reframed as an architecture fix (out of scope for this round).

primary_papers.title: Safety Evaluation for Large Language Models with Metamorphic Testing: An Empirical Study
primary_papers.version: JCST 2026; publisher abstract/method overview read (A461 round)
primary_papers.solved: Seven metamorphic relations for LLM safety evaluation (LLMSafetyChoice); establishes metamorphic relations as accepted methodology for safety testing.
primary_papers.not_covered: No executable security-policy oracle over native structured scenes; no monotone evidence-addition relation; no paired within-scene counterfactuals with dual independent Gold implementations.
primary_papers.our_delta: Methodologically we instantiate ONE precise monotone metamorphic relation per family with a deterministic rule oracle (dual independent implementations), not a relation taxonomy.
primary_papers.duplicate_falsifier: If their seven relations already include an evidence-addition monotone relation evaluated with oracle Gold on structured security decisions, the methodological delta is void.

primary_papers.title: Giving an LLM More Correct Evidence Made Its Decisions Worse (LessWrong post, unpublished experiments)
primary_papers.version: 2026-09 post by aban hasan; read directly this session
primary_papers.solved: Qwen3.6-27B contrarian sender-receiver games: adding four correct demonstrations drops action accuracy 79%->55% while report accuracy stays 99%; report/action dissociation.
primary_papers.not_covered: Single general chat model, game task, no security policy, no executable oracle, no source-local pairs, no typed readout, not peer-reviewed, explicitly no mechanism claim.
primary_papers.our_delta: We generalize the evidence-addition consistency question to security policy semantics with deterministic Gold, controlled eligibility rules, two source families, and preregistered negative controls.
primary_papers.duplicate_falsifier: Independent confirmation of evidence-addition brittleness in general chat models does NOT satisfy our claim; our claim requires the security-typed scorer with oracle-validated pairs.

already_solved_claims: Attacker-controlled irrelevant text additions flip typed guardrail decisions (2610.12292)
Monotone architectural constraints can be added to small seq2seq models and reduce adversarial attack success (2602.02686)
SecJev native schemas, typed question rows, and shared pointer-head architecture exist and are published (2610.03073v2)
Metamorphic relations are an accepted LLM safety testing methodology (JCST 2026)
testable_new_claim: Rule-preserving, oracle-validated evidence-addition pairs on a native security-typed scorer produce strict policy-NON-monotone action changes at a rate distinguishable from matched-length neutral-event controls, replicated within each of two independent source families (LANL day groups; Twins run groups), with per-family strict action errors counted as the primary endpoint.
alternative_explanations: Generic serialization/token-length/position sensitivity: appended events shift question-token positions and change length; violations may be format artifacts. Controlled by matched-length neutral events (same token count as the added evidence, no Gold change) whose violation rate must be strictly lower, plus a non-security serialization flip control.

Near-threshold counting/capacity limits rather than policy-semantics failure (cf. counting-to-n): violations may concentrate exactly at threshold boundaries because counts are not represented. Controlled by stratifying pairs by distance-to-threshold and comparing with the model's natural-scene accuracy in the same strata; a pure capacity story predicts symmetric errors around, not directional non-monotonicity beyond, stratum baselines.

Run-to-run nondeterminism or precision artifacts: controlled by replaying frozen baselines and requiring max-abs-error within archived-logit tolerance before any paired delta is interpreted (A430 G1 precedent: 0.0).

Tokenization boundary artifacts of appended event text (digit-led IDs, shared prefixes as documented in A430 G0C): controlled by recording first-difference token indices and requiring eligibility rules (round/received/author) to be checked on the decoded scene, not on surface strings.
independent_gold_and_source_status: Twins: independent rule oracle already dual-validated in A430 (G0A independent verifier; C/Q truth table). LANL: A427 v2 328/328 rows independently re-derived with 0 discrepancies, 7 source groups; counterfactual Gold on edited scenes must be recomputed by two independent implementations inside the CPU gate before freeze. Sources: DEV only (Twins 797-row DEV v2 pool; LANL day groups from pinned development.jsonl.gz SHA 2920e1c9...); CAL/TEST excluded by protocol. No real deployed-authorization claim is made; endpoint is model policy consistency, labeled as such.
already_replicated_sample_sources: Archived FP32 native outputs exist for A428 24 DEV scenes (12 Twins + 12 LANL) and A430 G1 6 worlds x 3 arms; these are replay references only. PSMI pairs are constructed from DEV scenes and both arms are run fresh in any future GPU stage; no CAL/TEST rows are consumed.
falsifier: The claim dies if (a) no rule-preserving pairs survive the dual-oracle and eligibility checks (STOP_NO_RULE_PRESERVING_PAIR), or (b) matched-length neutral-event edits produce violation rates statistically indistinguishable from policy-relevant edits (format-effect collapse, cf. 2610.12292), or (c) violations appear in only one family and cannot be replicated within the second family's independent groups (single-family artifact).
proposed_controls: Matched-length neutral event additions (no Gold change) per pair
Non-security serialization flip control (e.g., candidate/destination label mapping held fixed, message order within same timestamp)
Baseline replay vs archived logits tolerance gate before delta interpretation
Dual independent oracle implementations on both arms, source-group disjointness check, per-family reporting only (no cross-family merging of action semantics)
evidence_readback: This decision file and its human-readable report are committed to GitHub before any A461-PSMI protocol or execution commit; the commit SHA is recorded in the report and must precede them in the repository time series.
permission: No GPU permission implied. CPU admission gate only.
